quandoUsar: Names and short texts that are read far more than edited: project title, file name, description.
Editing that saves field by field, with no form: `onSave` can return a promise, and the new text appears right away while it runs.
Headings that need to stay headings: `as` keeps the text in an `h1`, `h2`, `h3`, `p`, or `span`.
quandoEvitar: Use `input` or `textarea` in a form when several fields need to be saved together.
Use `rich-text-editor` when the text needs formatting.
When leaving the field must not save: here losing focus saves, as in a rename, and only `Esc` discards.

teclado.acao: On the text, enter edit mode with all the content selected.
In the field, saves; does not fire during an IME composition.
Cancels the edit, restores the text, and returns focus to it.
Moves through the save and cancel buttons; when focus leaves the component, the text is saved.

acessibilidade: At rest the text is a `<button>` with an `aria-label` in the format “label: value” and the hint `Activate to edit.`; while editing it becomes an `<input>` or `<textarea>` with the same `label`.
The `validate` error is tied to the field by `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby`, and the saving and saved notices go out in a `role="status"` region.
The hints, the announcements, and the failure message (with the `Try again` button) are fixed in English; only `label`, `placeholder`, and the `validate` text come from you.
movimento: The text becomes a field in the same place and with the same metrics; the frame follows the width of what is typed with a fast spring and, with `multiline`, the height.

On save, the new text stays dimmed next to a spinning indicator until the promise resolves, and then a checkmark draws itself; on failure, the saved text comes back and the frame flashes in an error tone.
With “reduce motion” on, sizes change instantly, texts only fade, and the saving indicator does not spin.
responsivo: The row reserves 66 px on the right for the buttons (38 px with `multiline`), so the text does not change wrapping on entering edit mode; on a single line, the excess is cut with an ellipsis.
notasIA: `value` is the saved value and `onSave(next)` must store it: return a promise and reject it for the component to restore the last saved value and offer a retry.
`validate(next)` returns the error message or nothing; before that the text is trimmed and, on a single line, repeated spaces become one, and `onSave` is not called if nothing changed.
`label` is required (it is the accessible name and does not show on screen), `variant` is `title` or `body`, and `as` chooses the tag, for example `as="h2"`.
